subtitle: Lesson 68 · Added Projects — Capstones

code:
Malformed event      -> dead-letter table
Duplicate redelivery -> idempotent MERGE absorbs it
Missing export file  -> alert, never a silent skip
Silver/gold failure  -> retry with backoff, then page
caption: Production-ready means surviving these, not avoiding them.

code:
Retry is only safe because the MERGE is idempotent:
re-running it produces the same result either way.
caption: Without idempotency, "just retry it" is a corruption risk.

code:
SLO:   99% of events visible in gold within 15 min
Alert: fires if the gold job hasn't run in the last hour
caption: The alert fires well before the SLO breaches — a warning, not a postmortem.
